_comment: MUMia expression marks, copied verbatim from mumu-solutions/mumu-mumia at
tag v1.0.0, path dist/png/expressions/. Same shape as images/brand/MANIFEST.json.
dist/ in the mascot repo is generated and never hand-edited; these bytes are
a straight copy, so a drift check is a byte comparison against that tag.
Two files per expression because dist/ assets are baked to a single colorway
(mumu-mumia COMPLIANCE 3.3: a theme-aware SVG rasterises to a silhouette, so
there is no one image that works on both grounds). The error pages pick one
with <picture media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)">, so only one downloads.
Naming: '-dark-' is the DARK-THEME colorway, for a dark ground. Note this is
the opposite of images/brand/logo-wordmark-*, where '-light-' is the
light-COLOURED mark used on a dark ground.
The site auditor lists these as orphans because it only resolves references
from index.html. They are used by the error pages, which it does not read.
